Mark Carney Discusses Global Investment and Economic Stability

Mark Carney, former Governor of the Bank of England and UN Special Envoy for Climate Action and Finance, delivered a speech at the Canada Investment Summit. He discussed the need for global investment to drive economic growth and stability. Carney highlighted the role of private capital in addressing global challenges and fostering development. His remarks touched upon the broader economic landscape and the importance of strategic financial initiatives.
